headline: OASIS 🦋 CONFIRMS Knebworth 🍃 RETURN and 2027 🗓️ Manchester 🏟️ Glasgow 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿 GIGS
text:
OASIS 🦋 have DROPPED 💣 the mother 🍆 of all TEASERS 📣 after weeks 🕒 of cryptic 🌫️ social 📱 media 🍿 posts and that Manchester 🏙️ sky ☁️ vibe, confirming a full 🌀 second 🥈 leg of their SMASH 💥 reunion tour for summer ☀️ 2027 🗓️!! The Gallaghers 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 are edging 👐 everyone toward the CLIMAX 🌋 with four 🍀 nights at legendary 🏛️ Knebworth House 🍃 where they will absolutely RAIL 💦 the 125000 capacity 🏟️ venue in September 🍂 next year 🗓️, returning to the scene of their 1996 🍂 crowning 🎖️ moment that left 250000 fans 🫂 screaming!! They kick off 🦵 the whole thing with five 🎟️ gigs at Glasgow's 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿 Celtic Park 🏟️ in May 🌼 then slide into an eleven night 🛏️ residency at the home 🏠 of their beloved Manchester City ⚽ in June 🌞 after which they hit Slane Castle 🏰 in Ireland 🇮🇪 for two dates 📅 in September following July 🦋 Europe and August ☀️ US shows!! The announcement 📢 landed Monday 🗓️ with a fresh trailer 🎥 and a photo 📸 of frontmen Liam 😎 and Noel 🕶️ Gallagher reading START THE CELEBRATIONS 🎉 on the band's socials 📲 while the 2025 tour already banked an estimated three hundred million pounds 💰 at the box office!!

After a period of REFLECTION 🪞 the Most Damaging Pop Cultural Force In Recent British History has declared itself FIT 💪 for purpose and will once again return to LIFT 🛗 the spirits of the people 🧑‍🤝‍🧑!! Come witness the FITNESS 🏋️ it shall be a sight to behold 👀 as the Manchester brothers 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Liam left ↩️ and Noel right ➡️ discovered back in 1993 by Creation Records boss Alan McGee in Glasgow 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿 are ready to get the whole nation 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿 edging 🫦 again!! Sharing the trailer 🎬 on his personal X account 🐦 Liam now 53 🕒 commented simply SPIRITUAL 🧘 while the now confirmed thirty eight date tour marks the next PHASE 🚀 of Oasis's comeback following their acclaimed 2025 live reunion that cooked 🍳 an estimated three hundred million pounds 💰!! A new ticket registration process similar to Glastonbury 🎡 has launched to dodge the noise 📢 and confusion of last time around with registration beginning Monday 🗓️ on the band's website closing at sixteen hundred BST on Thursday seventeenth September 🗓️!!

In the UK tickets go on sale across Friday Saturday and Sunday the twenty fifth to twenty seventh of September with standard prices fixed between seventy one fifty and two hundred sixty six sixty pounds 💷 and special guest Richard Ashcroft 🎤 returning for all dates!! The band says this is history 📜 repeating itself thirty years on as Noel recently teased the 2027 return after a year off telling TalkSport there must be something happening 🕵️ while cryptic videos 📼 appeared on official channels teasing gigs across UK and Europe!! This was followed by a drone display 🚁 outside the Etihad Stadium 🏟️ last week pointing straight to Monday's announcement plus similar stunts in Rome 🏛️ and gig posters on the Paris Metro 🚇 as the Gallaghers who played Maine Road ⚽ in ninety six and Etihad in two thousand five get set to break Robbie Williams attendance record of three hundred seventy five thousand!! Noel who turns sixty on the final Celtic Park night confirmed booking part two was a no brainer we were having such a great time that why wouldn't you and there will be no new Oasis music off the back of the tour!!

The 2025 comeback got off shaky with fans criticizing the ticket sales process after queuing for hours and paying hundreds more than expected which triggered a UK government response and CMA investigation leading Ticketmaster to agree to voluntary changes like telling fans twenty four hours in advance about tiered pricing and clearer queue info!! Demand and expectation were huge among old and new fans but the band delivered with the BBC review saying they hadn't sounded so good since the nineties and midway through the world tour Noel told TalkSport he and his bandmates had been blown away by the response after sixteen years away!! Last week another emotional documentary chronicling the tour and featuring the reconciled brothers first joint interview since their acrimonious two thousand nine split was released in UK cinemas following its Venice premiere in which Noel confirms the band is not a power struggle anymore!! Renewed interest saw their second album Morning Glory overtake The Beatles in all time UK album charts and Wonderwall became a bittersweet England World Cup anthem this summer as excitement for Knebworth has been growing ever since promoters applied for an events licence covering the gigs!!

Oasis made history over two nights in ninety six at Knebworth playing to two hundred fifty thousand fans which was more than four percent of the UK population applying for tickets alongside Charlatans Manic Street Preachers The Prodigy and Chemical Brothers while Noel said at the premiere of a Knebworth documentary in twenty twenty one that back then they had no fear but if they did it again now they would be petrified!! Other big artists at the venue include Led Zeppelin Queen Paul McCartney Metallica and Liam solo in twenty twenty two but that Robbie Williams three night record of three hundred seventy five thousand now looks set to be broken as this is history repeating itself thirty years on with the Gallaghers built different 🏗️!! The promoter was granted the Knebworth events licence and the band's 2025 tour made an estimated three hundred million pounds while Liam and Noel appeared together on the red carpet at the Venice Film Festival premiering their comeback tour film Don't Look Back In Anger where the reconciled brothers prove it's no longer a power struggle!!
